support: Plan each dig

Tap an unexplored cell to reveal it. Opening a gem spends its mining cost immediately. Tap the mined gem again to collect it for free and earn XP. Empty cells and clue numbers are free; a clue adds the mining costs in its eight neighboring cells. Red warning marks count neighboring lethal mines.
Recover stamina and keep exploring

Stamina may reach zero. Eat a revealed hamburger when you need a full refill, or upgrade manually after earning enough XP. Restarting a failed floor creates a fresh map and restores that floor’s entry state. The interactive practice tutorial is available when starting a new game and from the in-game help page.
Free opening and full expedition

The opening district has three free floors and a camp shop. Leaving that first camp opens the one-time Unlock all field sites purchase. The unlock covers the remaining campaign across eight districts and 24 floors, with no subscription. Apple displays the price in your App Store currency. Camp items use earned game coins, not real money.
Purchase and restore help

Purchases are processed by Apple. Use Restore purchases on the unlock page with the same Apple Account that made the purchase. A pending purchase unlocks after Apple confirms it; canceling preserves your progress. If prices or purchases are unavailable, check your connection, retry, and contact us if the issue continues. Do not buy again to resolve an existing purchase. Apple refund requests are handled at reportaproblem.apple.com.
Progress and sound

Load Progress resumes the expedition saved on this device. New Game replaces the current expedition; completed local scores and sound settings remain. Settings lets you adjust music and effects or return to the main menu. This release has local scores and no online account or developer-operated cloud sync. Device backups are controlled by Apple and your settings.
Contact support

Email support@ideaspike.com with the app version, device, iOS version and a short description of the problem. Do not send passwords, full payment details or unnecessary personal information. TestFlight transactions use Apple’s sandbox and do not charge real money.
privacy: The app and your data

Understone is a mineral-deduction game. It does not require an app account. We do not collect or send your gameplay, progress, local scores or sound settings to IdeaSpike servers, and we do not use advertising, tracking or third-party analytics in the app.
Information on your device

The app saves your current expedition, discovered specimens, completed local scores and sound settings in its local storage. New Game replaces the current expedition but retains completed scores and sound settings. Deleting the app removes its local app data; copies may remain in device backups managed by Apple. The app does not operate cross-device synchronization.
Apple purchases

Apple processes the one-time full-expedition purchase. The app receives product, storefront and verified transaction information from StoreKit to display the local price, check your unlock and restore it. We do not receive your payment-card details or Apple Account password, and the app does not send transaction information to an IdeaSpike server. Apple’s own privacy terms govern its purchase processing.
Optional external links

Geological research, music credits, support and privacy links open external pages only when you choose them. Those websites and your browser may process information under their own privacy policies. The app does not automatically upload your expedition when opening a link.
Your choices and questions

You can play the opening district without making a purchase, adjust sound settings, replace the current expedition or remove the app. Purchases and refunds are managed through Apple. Email support@ideaspike.com for privacy questions; any information you choose to send in a support email is used to respond to your request. Do not include passwords or payment-card details.
Policy updates
This policy describes the current release. We will update it if the app’s data practices change.

设备上的信息
当前探险、已发现标本、已完成的本地成绩和声音设置保存在应用的本地存储中。“新游戏”替换当前探险，并保留完成成绩和声音设置。删除应用会删除其本地应用数据；Apple 管理的设备备份中可能仍有副本。应用不提供跨设备同步。

仅在你主动选择时，地质研究、音乐鸣谢、支持和隐私链接才会打开外部网页。这些网站和浏览器可能按各自的隐私政策处理信息。打开链接不会自动上传你的探险数据。

你可以不购买而体验第一个矿区，也可调整声音、替换当前探险或移除应用。购买和退款由 Apple 管理。隐私问题可发送至 support@ideaspike.com；你主动提供的支持邮件信息仅用于回复请求。请勿包含密码或付款卡资料。
政策更新
本政策描述当前版本。若应用的数据处理方式变化，我们会更新此政策。
